top_signals.title: Key China Steel Price Hits Near-Decade Low on Construction Slump
top_signals.summary: The price of a key Chinese steel product has dropped to the lowest in almost a decade as a prolonged property downturn sapped construction demand and swelled inventories.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Four dead, 15 injured in Thailand school shooting
top_signals.summary: The shooter, who is reported to have died, was identified as a teenage student of the school in Nonthaburi province, just north of Bangkok.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
